blends.name: KOW X WR Turbo Turtle Upgrade
blends.desc:
Blend any colour [Turbo Turtle](https://wax.atomichub.io/market?collection_name=waxiestrace5&match=turbo%20turtle&order=asc&schema_name=cars&sort=price&symbol=WAX) with a [Konceptonwax X WAXiest Races Vinyl](https://wax.atomichub.io/market?collection_name=konceptonwax&order=asc&schema_name=collab&sort=price&symbol=WAX&template_id=294790) to create one of three Turbo Turtle KOW's.

Adding this vinyl to your [Turbo Turtle](https://wax.atomichub.io/market?collection_name=waxiestrace5&match=turbo%20turtle&order=asc&schema_name=cars&sort=price&symbol=WAX) will increase it's level from level 0 - level 1

Find out how you can earn a Konceptonwax X WAXiest Races Vinyl by joining the following Discords.

[Konceptonwax](https://discord.com/invite/h8HTMEYUF5)
[WAXiest Races](https://discord.gg/WQgrczbcAC)

**The three Turbo Turtle KOW variants are all level 1 and are only cosmetically different.**
